scope: mask-only independent review; no generated H&E was available or used

decisions.reason: Hard gates pass, but candidate 03 better preserves source-like instance size, total count, spacing and clustering under the same tissue geometry and quota.
Hard gates pass, but candidate 03 has lower count inflation, closer nearest-neighbor spacing, less excess clustering and better size preservation.
All hard gates pass and mask review shows coherent localized immune enrichment. Candidate 03 best preserves source-relative size, count, spacing and clustering under the high fixed cell quota.
decisions.tissue_geometry: The 46,090-pixel change occupies the authorized stroma-to-immune region while preserving adjacent tumor and non-target compartments.
decisions.nucleus_layout: One hundred fourteen class-2 nuclei are complete, non-overlapping and contained. Source-relative area-p95, count, NND and Ripley ratios are 0.842, 1.587, 0.840 and 1.570, best among the passing alternatives.
decisions.coupling: Added immune nuclei occupy authorized changed tissue and transitions; quota, seam, compatibility, distribution and density gates pass with sampling score 0.892.
decisions.preserved_conditions: Protected nuclei, prohibited regions and support-exterior instances remain unchanged without partial-instance, overlap, border or containment violations.
decisions.limitations: The target is substantially denser and more clustered than source, although within frozen limits. Mask-only evidence does not establish generated-H&E quality or clinical validity.
decisions.verdict: Approve candidate 03 as the single mask-condition handoff.
